title: Per-Phase Manifest as Harness-Layer Specification Format
summary: Adopts the YAML per-phase manifest format from Spike S2 as the canonical Harness-Layer specification for Tier 1 mechanism artifact requirements, living at `hooks/manifests/tier1-phase-manifest.yaml`. Each RDD phase lists required mechanisms with a canonical name, a path template (with `{cycle}` substitution), a byte-size floor, and required headers/fields, which a Stop hook checks against at phase end. The manifest fully catches State B (missing artifact) and trivial State C (thin fabricated stubs) but not sophisticated State C, which requires the compound check specified in ADR-064.
mechanism: YAML per-phase manifest of required Tier 1 mechanism artifacts (path, size floor, required headers/fields)

links.note: ADR-063 specifies the manifest format; ADR-064 specifies the hook mechanism (Stop hook) that consumes it, and the two decisions compose into the Harness-Layer compound check.
